ALCHEMY_STARS_EVENT_ALCHEMY_STARS_ZETA.p: Hero Zeta's palace. You may take one of his keepsakes.
ALCHEMY_STARS_EVENT_ALCHEMY_STARS_WILLIA: Hermit Master William sits among books. You may take one of his gifts.
ALCHEMY_STARS_EVENT_ALCHEMY_STARS_ZETA.t: Can you tell this hero about this place?
I... this hero can trade these things!

You saw nothing!
Take it and go!
How about telling me your story!
ALCHEMY_STARS_EVENT_ALCHEMY_STARS_WILLIA:
「A splendid youth sits on the palace floor...
surrounded by books.」

Wary of the tea here?
Then what help do you want?
Sit. What hospitality do you seek?

But observing others is like reading.
A new book feels fine.

About the story you once told...
it inspired me somewhat.
NEOW.talk.ALCHEMY_STARS_CHARACTER_ALCHEM:
A foreign... guest...
Your memories... strewn about...

Hello—where is this?
My course seems to have gone wrong.

The answer... lies at the summit...
Arm yourself... with your memories...

You... awoke...
I... found you... at the base...

Thank you.
Uh... ah! We have to start over?

You must reach the summit... kill him...
before you can... return...
Combat... is inevitable...

You are... trapped...
I will... help you...

It's fine—we've found the trick.
Thank you for always helping.

Bless you... foreign colors...
Go end... his dominion...
ALCHEMY_STARS_EVENT_ALCHEMY_STARS_ENLIGH: Father, this unit is ready to explore.
ALCHEMY_STARS_ENLIGHTENER.talk.ALCHEMY_S: Father, this unit is ready to explore.
ALCHEMY_STARS_EVENT_ALCHEMY_STARS_ENLIGH:
This place is strange.
Stay and support us.
ALCHEMY_STARS_ENLIGHTENER.talk.ALCHEMY_S:
This place is strange.
Stay and support us.
ALCHEMY_STARS_EVENT_ALCHEMY_STARS_ENLIGH: Father, that was a close call.
ALCHEMY_STARS_ENLIGHTENER.talk.ALCHEMY_S: Father, that was a close call.
ALCHEMY_STARS_EVENT_ALCHEMY_STARS_ENLIGH: Thankfully your beacon got us back.
ALCHEMY_STARS_ENLIGHTENER.talk.ALCHEMY_S: Thankfully your beacon got us back.
ALCHEMY_STARS_EVENT_ALCHEMY_STARS_ENLIGH: Shall we try a different route this time?
ALCHEMY_STARS_ENLIGHTENER.talk.ALCHEMY_S: Shall we try a different route this time?
ALCHEMY_STARS_EVENT_ALCHEMY_STARS_ENLIGH: Father, cheat mode may be necessary.
ALCHEMY_STARS_ENLIGHTENER.talk.ALCHEMY_S: Father, cheat mode may be necessary.
ALCHEMY_STARS_EVENT_ALCHEMY_STARS_ENLIGH:
Lock onto Aurora power and fight!
Ah—doesn't work here.
ALCHEMY_STARS_ENLIGHTENER.talk.ALCHEMY_S:
Lock onto Aurora power and fight!
Ah—doesn't work here.
OROBAS.talk.ALCHEMY_STARS_CHARACTER_ALCH:
You mean these fictional lights?
All thanks to that Regent's help.
So pretty! Pick a gift! I repay you!!!
Still hunting the Collector? Try harder! Try harder!
Good friend! You're here! Look what I found!

Thanks for always helping.
We may leave any time now.

I'll miss everyone a little.
Take care of yourself too.
TEZCATARA.talk.ALCHEMY_STARS_CHARACTER_A: Oh, what a lovely bunch—hello there.
Hello—may we rest here a while?
Of course. Come closer; let me look at you.

Welcome back, little dears.
Have some hot soup to warm up.
[i][font_size=22]「The Caelestite stops Vice from helping in the kitchen.」[/font_size][/i]

Thank you for hosting us.
We may leave soon.

I'm so happy for you.
Anything to burn before you go?
PAEL.talk.ALCHEMY_STARS_CHARACTER_ALCHEM: Are you going to fight the Collector too?

I'd rather not fight, if possible.
I just want to go home.

Let that go...
Without combat, you cannot reach the top...

Take a part of me—
it's the best.

(Vice's eyes look weird.
This is definitely not food.)
Pael is asleep; its breathing shakes the room.
[i][font_size=22]「The Sky Carrier quietly carries everyone away without waking the big friend.」[/font_size][/i]
DARV.talk.ALCHEMY_STARS_CHARACTER_ALCHEM:
What? Another peddler...?
Fine—got anything worth trading?

[i][font_size=22]「But Karen and Vice immediately show their spoils—
the trade seems on.」[/font_size][/i]

Name a price...
How much for that colossus of yours?

The Sky Carrier is my friend,
not something for sale.
Let me dig... for what you asked...

We may leave anytime—
here, a rare piece I brought.

What?!
Fine... I'll give you something good this time...
ALCHEMY_STARS_EVENT_ALCHEMY_STARS_ZETA.t:
Caelestites?! Why you?!
Where is this?
Has Hero Zeta finally arrived in a world that needs saving?!

Calm down. Roughly speaking...
This place looks safe. Don't wander.

So confusing...
Anyway, you'll help this hero get back, right?
Perfect—this hero found some things. Take a look.

Caelestites! Weren't you going up?
Why come from below?!

Take me with you? I can't race here—it's...
so... so... so boring—

Look! This hero made a local friend!
Huh? Why did it run from you?
That's the one who stole our food last time...

Until we return, be careful.
Don't befriend weird strangers!
ALCHEMY_STARS_EVENT_ALCHEMY_STARS_WILLIA:
[i][font_size=22]「A splendid youth sits on the palace floor...
surrounded by books.」[/font_size][/i]

...Mr. William?
Somehow I'm not surprised to see you.
Sit. I've waited long for you.

Too much here fascinates me.
I won't leave yet.
But we have to go back.
I'll keep helping. Do your best.
Hermit Master, you seem to be enjoying this.

Seeking truth means welcoming the unknown.
When the time comes, I won't linger.

For now...
let us enjoy this drift together.
Good eyes. You've found the trick.
Need you ask? Go, young one.

Me? Don't worry.
Frostnight Gentleman and I will ride the current home.
NONUPEIPE.talk.ALCHEMY_STARS_CHARACTER_A: Come—though you already shine, pick some blessings anyway.
We meet again; your radiance hasn't faded.
Results weren't great, but we'll keep trying.
Every time I see you, that light holds my eyes.

Thank you for always helping.
We may leave anytime.
No matter—have some tea, then take my parting gifts.
VAKUU.talk.ALCHEMY_STARS_CHARACTER_ALCHE:
Another guest from the stars?
Welcome—you look like you need help.

Here—take this contract and read it fully.
Sign only if informed, willing, and accepting all related duties.

Need a new contract?
Looks like you really do.
No no no—these are predatory terms. I won't sign.

Just a tiny price.
You wouldn't want to miss help for the summit, would you?
Don't show me that! I absolutely will NOT sign!

What if the freebie concerns Caelesta?
Aren't you curious about its past?
TANX.talk.ALCHEMY_STARS_CHARACTER_ALCHEM: Warrior who rides a dragon—what do you fight with?!!
I usually don't fight directly—I support my friends.

Teamwork's fine! But no weapons?!
Pick any—let's fight!!!
[i][font_size=22]「Everyone scrambles into a brawl with Tanx.」[/font_size][/i]
Uh... we're not fighting again, right?
[i][font_size=22]「Catching on, the Caelestite grabs the weapons and flees on the colossus.」[/font_size][/i]
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.ALCHEMY_STARS_CHARACT:
Hello? I don't know your purpose...
but will you let us leave?
Continue

Travelers who drift here... does a home truly exist?
Or is it a lie—a scrap of memory?
You've seen memories fabricated.
Why trust the destination exists?
Continue

Such rich colors—stay for me a while.
Until that world and those memories become a collection.
I promise you'll have everything as before.
Continue
Stop being stirred by others. Wait.

We weren't finished last time!
Someone is waiting for us...
Our home is real!
Continue
We have no time for your collecting.
Continue

You...
If one light holds every color, is it still "colorless"?
Perhaps a "dye" born of that could recolor everything.
Continue

Excellent seed—stop.
I don't want you swallowed by what lies ahead.
Tell me how to go back!
Continue

You're back?
No matter how many times you try, you...
Continue

Even so, we'll keep trying.
Someday, we will...

I came to say goodbye.
We'll defeat you, then go home.
Continue

Is farewell courtesy—or obsession?
Why keep this ritual
after I've crushed you countless times?
Continue

I just want to settle this with you.
I still don't understand you, but I'll say goodbye.
And we've long been ready to return.
Continue
Sky Carrier—prepare for return!

ALCHEMY_STARS_EVENT_ALCHEMY_STARS_WILLIA: Ah, you're here. A bit slower than I expected.
ALCHEMY_STARS_ANCIENT_ALCHEMY_STARS_WILL: Ah, you're here. A bit slower than I expected.
NEOW.talk.ALCHEMY_STARS_CHARACTER_ALCHEM: Are you well... travelers of foreign hues...
DARV.talk.ALCHEMY_STARS_CHARACTER_ALCHEM: Last trip didn't go well, huh? Want something?
NONUPEIPE.talk.ALCHEMY_STARS_CHARACTER_A: Come closer—let me take another good look at you.
VAKUU.talk.ALCHEMY_STARS_CHARACTER_ALCHE: Given your situation, I've drafted a new contract.
